notes: Restoration Hardware / rh.com. ACCESS: same as bs6.json - direct HTTP and Playwright headless both hard 403-blocked by DataDome across every path (including robots.txt); Claude-in-Chrome (real authenticated browser) got past the block and was used for the actual page inspection. robots.txt (fetched via Claude-in-Chrome) has no Claude-specific full-site disallow, and lists 'Disallow: /catalog/sale/' (crawl-only restriction, confirms a /catalog/sale/ path exists) among other path-specific disallows. SALE-VS-CLEARANCE TEST: the homepage's only sale-adjacent nav item is 'SALE', which resolves to https://rh.com/us/en/sale. Opened and read that page's own copy: the hero reads 'the LABOR DAY sale / SAVE UP TO 70% / ON HUNDREDS OF NEW ITEMS / WHILE QUANTITIES LAST', followed by per-room tiles (Living, Dining, Bedroom, Bath, Outdoor, Rugs, Lighting, Bedding, Bath Towels) each with its own 'SAVE UP TO NN%' banner and a SHOP link. Every SHOP link resolves to a normal RH category page (standard /catalog/category/products.jsp/catNNNNN or collections.jsp/catNNNNN URL shape, same template used by RH's regular category taxonomy) rather than any distinct Clearance/Outlet section - i.e. these are ordinary category pages filtered to reduced-price stock for a named calendar promotion (Labor Day), not a permanent clearance/outlet merchandising concept. This is a textbook temporary promotional campaign per the brief's own exclusion example (named holiday sale, percent-off framing, 'while quantities last') - not ambiguous, so it is excluded rather than flagged. RH OUTLET CHECK (per task instruction): navigated to rhoutlet.com directly - it redirects straight to https://rh.com/us/en/store-locations/stores.jsp (RH's physical store locator on the main site). There is no separate RH Outlet e-commerce storefront/domain; 'RH Outlet' is a brick-and-mortar-only retail concept for this brand, so there is nothing further in scope as a Clearance PLP. No other 'Clearance/Outlet/Final Sale/Last Chance/End of Line' nav item, footer link, or homepage link was found (full main-nav scan and homepage href regex scan for sale|clearance|outlet performed - only /us/en/sale matched). Category mega-menu flyouts and RH's own internal search could not be fully exercised due to heavy Claude-in-Chrome tab-group contention from 9 concurrent workers sharing this session (tooling limitation, not a site block), so this is reported as a well-supported but not exhaustive absence.
